review_evidence: README identifies Alloy as a Lean 4 library for embedding external FFI code (currently C) directly in Lean and generating compilation shims.
Alloy modules, Main.lean and tests contain the parser/elaboration/FFI implementation and concrete interface behavior; these are reusable formal-programming interfaces rather than disposable examples.

Complete inspection of lakefile.lean found substantial project implementation rather than mere configuration: custom module facets, shim compilation, object-building logic and helper definitions. It is retained as unique Alloy/Lake prior art.
summary: Retain the complete Alloy implementation, including its substantive Lake facet code, CLI and formal interface tests.
